canonical_statement: For n >= 1 and 1 <= p < infinity, every nonnegative u in W^{1,p}(R^n) whose positive superlevel sets have finite measure has an equimeasurable symmetric decreasing rearrangement uStar in W^{1,p}(R^n), and the L^p seminorm of a weak gradient of uStar is no greater than that of u.
domain_and_universes: n : Nat; p : ENNReal; u : (Fin n -> Real) -> Real; weak gradients valued in Fin n -> Real; product Lebesgue volume; Prop in universe 0

encoding_decisions.vanishing_at_infinity: every positive superlevel has finite product-Lebesgue measure
